findings.source_passage: I could have greeted my dear Pacific with uncounted thanks, for now the long supplication of my youth was answered; that serene ocean rolled eastwards from me a thousand leagues of blue
findings.why_it_matters: This is the narrator's only autobiographical, self-disclosing moment in the chapter — the 'long supplication of my youth' — and the lyric 'thousand leagues of blue' is one of the chapter's most quotable phrases. Its erasure removes Ishmael's personal voice entirely from the opening and converts a narrator-driven meditation into mere scene-setting.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the clause beginning 'were it not for other things, I could have greeted my dear Pacific…' verbatim or near-verbatim; the autobiographical register and the phrase 'thousand leagues of blue' must survive.

findings.source_passage: like those fabled undulations of the Ephesian sod over the buried Evangelist St. John
findings.why_it_matters: This simile is one of the most critically remarked images in the chapter, yoking the Pacific's mystery to Christian mysticism and classical legend. Its removal flattens the theological-mythological texture that critics depend on when reading this chapter as Melville's sacred geography.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the St. John / Ephesian simile following 'hidden soul beneath'; it can be slightly compressed but the proper nouns and the image must remain.

findings.source_passage: To any meditative Magian rover, this serene Pacific, once beheld, must ever after be the sea of his adoption
findings.why_it_matters: This sentence is among the most quoted in the chapter and in Melville criticism; 'meditative Magian rover' is a signature phrase that defines the chapter's mystical-contemplative register and frames the cosmic geography that follows. Its total absence is a major signature loss.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'To any meditative Magian rover, this serene Pacific, once beheld, must ever after be the sea of his adoption' verbatim as the opening of the third paragraph.

findings.source_passage: wide-rolling watery prairies and Potters' Fields of all four continents
findings.source_locator: paragraph 2, 'for here, millions of mixed shades'
findings.why_it_matters: 'Potters' Fields of all four continents' is a distinctive, interpretively loaded image linking the Pacific to a burial ground for the nameless dead of the world; its excision weakens the mortuary/dreaming motif that the paragraph otherwise sustains.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert 'wide-rolling watery prairies and Potters' Fields of all four continents' before the 'millions of mixed shades' clause.

findings.source_passage: in his very sleep, his ringing cry ran through the vaulted hull
findings.why_it_matters: 'Vaulted hull' carries architectural/cathedral resonance that 'the hull' does not; a minor but real prosodic and tonal loss.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'vaulted hull' in place of bare 'hull'.

summary: The draft erases three high-priority signatures — the autobiographical 'long supplication of my youth / thousand leagues of blue,' the Ephesian St. John simile, and the 'meditative Magian rover' sentence — stripping the chapter of its personal voice, its theological-mythological register, and its most critically remarked prose.
